procedure ClimbFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new climber, then follow up once"
  policy ClimbPolicy
  sheet Climbers "Climbers" { climber: Text, email: Email, climbs_left: Number, waiver_signed: Bool, last_visit: Date, status: Text, emergency_contact: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Climbers

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.climber}, thanks for signing up! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "row was removed"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "welcomed"
  wait 10 days
  let all = fetch Climbers
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.climber}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "row was removed"
  send ok2
}
